name: Email_Confirmation
rationale: Asserts that an unconfirmed customer cannot log in, which suite's configuration does not do: isDoubleOptInEnabled() defaults to false and suite adds no override, so registration is followed by a successful login. The sibling Cypress test proves exactly that in the same run. The gate itself is covered by the facade test, whose data provider mocks the config on and off and includes the unconfirmed-login case. A browser test cannot assert it without flipping a config the E2E environment does not flip.
